what: The clockwork: one object, gears at different speeds, each with its own tracker. Lines are read against their own gear as of their own date. DRAFT — every rule here is a proposal for Sailor.

gears.label: the pump
gears.tracker: SST — EIA US regular gasoline, retail (price.json)
gears.rule: every +10% at the pump since the war began = −0.2 z; capped at ±1
gears.readingShape: [date, z, sigma, pct change since war start]

gears.label: the vote
gears.tracker: exit polls (vote-cause tracker, to be built)
gears.rule: z = −(wrong − right) ÷ 100 on "was the war the right decision"

readings.source: NBC News exit poll, 2026-11-03, as reported by The Federalist (thefederalist.com/2026/11/03/exit-poll-iran-war-was-crucial-or-major-factor-for-3-in-4-voters/)

gears.note: only the election-day reading exists; a line dated before it is read against it as the nearest measurement and flagged

gears.label: the war itself
gears.tracker: the object's own state by date (a step line, not a measurement)
gears.rule: what the object had done to the no-war promise on that day: no war +0.5 · Israel strikes Iran without the US 0 · US strikes Iran (Fordow, Natanz, Isfahan) −0.5 · the war −1; sigma 0 (a fact, not a reading)
readings: Israel strikes Iran; no US boots
gears.note: added 11-07 for the crystal: lines dated before the war need a gear to be read against, and the war itself is the one every prediction was about. DRAFT for Sailor.

notAGear.shadow: a line about who is to blame for a reading, not the reading — no instrument sees it; its light is "unmeasured"
